summary: Iteration 16: tested hero stats change, directory search tracking + admin Search Gaps tab, article categories API, Blog category chips, admin Categories 'Used for' (article type), admin Articles category datalist input, and directory regression. Backend 11/11 pytest passed; all 9 requested features verified in UI via Playwright. No critical issues found; only minor UX/code-quality notes.

minor.issue: Public, unauthenticated, no rate limit and no max length on q. Anyone can flood db.searches or put very long strings into the admin Search Gaps view. Add something like q max_length=100 plus simple per-IP throttling.

ui_bugs.issue: After Clear (0 searches recorded) with 'only gaps' toggle ON, message reads 'No unmet searches yet — every search found something.' That's misleading when there are no searches at all. Show 'No searches recorded yet' when total_searches === 0.

issues: Search tracking runs inside the providers useEffect, so changing country/region/category/sort while q is set records extra duplicate searches for the same term. Partial terms typed with >900ms pauses are also recorded (e.g. 'car' then 'cardio'). This inflates counts.
The date range uses native <input type=date> (browser picker) instead of the shadcn calendar (likely the shared DateRangeBar, pre-existing)
The Searches/No results columns are narrow (grid auto cols), so the numbers sit off-center under their wider headers
Add button label reads 'Add categorie' (bad pluralization of entity name)

action_items: (Optional) Add max_length plus rate limiting to POST /api/search/track
(Optional) Only track search when q changes (not other filters) to avoid duplicate counts
(Optional) Fix Search Gaps empty-state wording when total_searches is 0
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is ~1815 lines; split SearchGapsManager, Campaigns, Quiz editor etc. into separate files
server.py ~1928 lines; consider routers per domain

CategorySelect fetches all /categories and filters type !== 'article' client-side. Fine now (only 'category' types exist), but specialty/niche types created via /admin/categories/sync would also show in the provider category dropdown. Prefer api.get('/categories', {params:{type:'category'}})
DELETE /api/admin/search-gaps wipes all history with no date scoping; acceptable but irreversible
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx (added data-testid='confirm-clear-searches-btn' to Search Gaps clear confirm action)
test_credentials: Admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; 2FA code read from mongo auth_challenges
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ articles/categories/campaign rows and TEST_zz searches were cleaned up. NOTE: the UI Clear test deleted ALL db.searches (this included a pre-existing 'dermatologist' entry).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: HL_TOKEN=<jwt> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_search_gaps_article_categories.py -v -n 0 (falls back to /tmp/hl_token; cleanup uses pymongo on localhost). Article category type value = 'article' (provider = 'category'). Blog chip testid = blog-cat-<name lowercased, spaces->'-'>. A site quiz popup ('This is a test' dialog with 'No thanks') opens on public pages after a few seconds and steals focus/blocks clicks; dismiss it in Playwright. 0 email/push subscribers, so publishing test articles sends nothing (it still creates campaign rows that need cleanup). 'dental' search returns 0 providers (genuine data gap).
